name: meeting-roi
description: Audits your recurring meetings over the last 4 weeks (7 to 56 days if you ask): for each series it reads your calendar (RSVPs, size, hours), looks for a notes document and the decisions or action items recorded in it, and counts chat follow-up in the meeting's channel (never message text). It proposes, from fixed rules you can read, which to cancel, shorten, shrink or keep, with the facts behind each and the person-hours a month each change would free. Attendance is RSVP-based. It never cancels, edits, declines or sends anything: a cancel is a proposal plus an optional note you can copy and send yourself. One-on-ones and meetings with external guests are not audited.

skills.name: Recurring meeting audit
skills.description: Scores each recurring meeting on RSVP acceptance, size, person-hours, notes, recorded decisions and chat follow-up, and proposes cancel / shorten / shrink / keep with the evidence and the hours saved. Read-only.
examples: Which of the meetings I organize could be cancelled?
How many hours do I spend in meetings with no notes?
